AN ACT

19-130, 19-142, 19-145, 19-158, 20-09, 20-22, 20-51, 20-59, 20-70,
20-123, 20-162, 20-170, 21-35, 21-66, 21-112, 21-127, 21-176, 21-198,
22-07, 22-110, 22-182, 23-86, 23-159 and 24-53, by amending sections 3,
4 and 6 thereof, to change the use and allottee of funds previously

social programs for the people of the states of Kosrae and Pohnpei, and
